items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: George, uh, Morris Moe. I've heard of him.

ctx.x: George, uh, Morris Moe. I've heard of him. Yeah, he was a fella about my car. Buddy Bertrand played over on the, uh, the piano around there. He was my, he was part of my car, yeah.
Did you hear Buddy Bertrand play music of him?
